title: Cartwise Grocery Orders: Timing Credit on Service-Fee Share Refunds
content:
# Cartwise Grocery Orders: timing credit on service-fee share refunds

**Rule.** When at least 2 calendar days have passed from the date of the order's completion to today and at least 2 item refunds stand on the order, a credit of 0.50 is added to the service-fee share refund; when at least 2 calendar days have passed and exactly 1 item refund stands, the credit is 0.25; otherwise there is no credit. The credit is added after the fee share is rounded to the cent, and it forms part of the service-fee share refund, which as a whole never exceeds the service fee billed less the service fee already returned on the order.

Days are calendar days counted from the date part of the completion time, which is day 0. Item refunds are counted as item refund entries standing on the order, whatever their reason.

## Case digest (hypothetical cases)

**Case 1.** A Cartwise Grocery Orders order completed at 21:40 on a 3rd is reviewed on the 5th. Two calendar days have passed. Three item refund entries stand on the order. Credit: 0.50.

**Case 2.** The same order reviewed on the 5th, with a single item refund entry standing. Credit: 0.25.

**Case 3.** The order was completed on the 4th and is reviewed on the 5th. One calendar day has passed. Credit: none, whatever the number of item refunds.

**Case 4.** Completed on the 3rd, reviewed on the 5th, no item refund entry standing. Credit: none.

**Case 5.** A rounded fee share of 1.24 with a credit of 0.50 gives 1.74; if the service fee billed less the service fee already returned is only 1.60, the refund is 1.60.

| Calendar days since completion | Item refund entries standing | Credit |
|---|---|---|
| 2 or more | 2 or more | 0.50 |
| 2 or more | Exactly 1 | 0.25 |
| 2 or more | None | None |
| 0 or 1 | Any | None |
